notes.title: Kill the Reaper available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26745627/57fcb8e3ff7fb1f8a6fc6d50e74a2a0b29e68c6f.png[/img]
Grim Reaper's perfect vacations was interrupted. Zombies wants revenge and now all hell breaks loose.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2694290]Kill the Reaper[/url][/b] is a minimalistic survival game with roguelite elements.

[list]
[*] Fight numerous zombies
[*] Unlock and customize various melee and ranged weapons
[*] Make special cocktails
[*] Level up and upgrade useful skills
[*] Survive as long as you can
[*] Get highest score through advanced score system
[/list]


Hold back armies of the dead and find out, how long does it take to [b]Kill the Reaper[/b]?

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2694290]KILL THE REAPER STORE PAGE[/url][/b]
